[[Chest of Ore]] is a reward for [[daily]] miner achievements.

== Acquisition ==
{{achievement list|reward=Chest of Ore|expandable=y}}

== Contents ==
* Three of the following:
** {{contains|Orichalcum Ore}} (1-3)
** {{contains|Mithril Ore}} (1-3)
** {{contains|Platinum Ore}} (1-3)
** {{contains|Gold Ore}} (1-3)
** {{contains|Silver Ore}} (1-3)
** {{contains|Iron Ore}} (1-3)
** {{contains|Copper Ore}} (1-3)
* {{contains|Writ of Experience|chance=Guaranteed}}
* {{contains|Resonating Sliver|chance=Guaranteed}}
* {{coin|150}} – {{coin|250}}

== Trivia ==
* Added to the game with the [[Game updates/2014-12-16|December 16, 2014]] update, as part of the reworked daily achievement system.
* Historical variants:
{{Item variant table header | only fields=icon,link }} !! Notes
